app.subtitle: Maine Coon Network
app.tagline: Quiet strength never rushes. The Vault is filling.
onboarding.welcome: The Guardians have been expecting someone.
onboarding.intro: Create your account and the Kingdom remembers you — your rank, your streak and your collection, on any device.
onboarding.noWallet: No wallet and no payment — ever.
leaderboard.title: Leaderboards
leaderboard.empty: No Guardians ranked yet. Be the first.
profile.signOutHint: Your progress lives on the account, not on this device. Sign back in with your name or address and password, a passkey, or a recovery code.
auth.title: Your account
auth.atRiskTitle: Forget this password and there is no way back
auth.atRiskBody: Email sending is not switched on yet, so a reset link cannot reach you. Add a passkey or generate recovery codes — either one gives you a second way in.
auth.secured: You have a second way in. A forgotten password would not lock you out.
auth.passkeyBody: Fingerprint, Face ID or your screen lock. Nothing to remember, and your phone syncs it so it survives a lost device.
auth.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys. Use a password or recovery codes.
auth.codesBody: Six one-time codes. The way back in when everything else is gone — keep them somewhere that is not your phone.
auth.codesModalBody: They are shown once and never again. Each one works a single time. Generating new codes cancels these.
auth.passwordRule: At least 10 characters. Length beats symbols.
auth.verifyUnavailable: Email sending is not switched on yet.
auth.emailDeliveryOff: Email delivery is not configured on this deployment, so confirmation and reset links cannot be sent yet. Your passkey and recovery codes are unaffected.
auth.externalBody: Built into the account system and switched off. Neither will ever be required to play or to keep your progress.
auth.signInBody: Your name or your email, and your password.
auth.signInFailed: That did not work. Check what you entered and try again.
auth.passkeyHint: Your device will ask for your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
auth.recoveryHint: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each works once.
auth.resetSent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way.
auth.resetUnavailable: Email sending is not switched on yet. Use a passkey or a recovery code.
auth.resetBadToken: This link has expired or has already been used.
auth.confirmBad: This link has expired or has already been used.
auth.error.EMAIL_TAKEN: That address is already on another account.
auth.error.EMAIL_INVALID: That does not look like an email address.
auth.error.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: That password is guessed too often. Pick another.
auth.error.LAST_METHOD: This is the only way into your account. Add another method first.
auth.error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
auth.resetNeedsEmail: Enter your email address to receive a reset link.
auth.credentialsBody: Changing either one asks for your current password first — a stolen session must not become a permanent takeover.
auth.error.HANDLE_TAKEN: That name is already taken in the Kingdom.
auth.error.PASSWORD_MISMATCH: The two passwords do not match.
auth.error.NO_PASSWORD: This account has no password yet.
install.title: Keep the Vault on your home screen
install.bodyAndroid: Install it like an app: its own icon, full screen, no browser bar. Nothing to download from a store.
install.bodyIos: Add it to your home screen and it opens like an app — its own icon, full screen, no browser bar.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
farcaster.failed: Farcaster sign-in did not work. You can still create an account below.
idle.slot.HEAD: Head
idle.bagEmpty: Nothing spare. Everything found is being worn.
idle.cap: Only the first {hours} hours are paid out.
idle.fallenBack: Carried back to the first chamber of floor {n}.
idle.losing: This one hits harder than the cat heals. More health, or more power.
idle.losingBoss: This Guardian kills the cat before it falls. Buy health, or hit harder.
idle.slow: Slow going. Gold still comes in — spend it.
idle.awayDefeats: Beaten {n} times while you were away.
leaderboard.depth.hint: Highest floor reached. The one everyone is chasing.
leaderboard.guardians.hint: Guardians felled. Six chambers each, and none of them easy.
leaderboard.fortune.hint: All the gold ever earned, spent or not.
rebirth.intro: Spend the run and start over. Level, gold, upgrades and equipment go; relics stay, and so does the record they are paid on.
rebirth.tooShallow: The Vault owes nothing below floor {n}. Climb higher first.
rebirth.noRecord: Relics are paid on record height only, and this record is already paid. Beat it to be owed more.
rebirth.warning: The floor, the gold, every upgrade and every piece worn or spare. All of it, now.
rebirth.shopHint: Bought once, kept through every rebirth after.
idle.sealActive: Seal of {rarity} · {n} pieces · +{bonus}% damage and health
flair.title: The Nose
flair.hint: Anything below this sells itself where it falls. It never reaches the bag.
rebirth.ladderHint: Five rungs, each a system rather than a bigger number. After the fifth, lives keep paying relics.
idle.packShare: The Pack adds {n}/s · {pct}% of the damage
shop.chestHint: One piece from the floor you are standing on, rolled on your own odds — the ones your lives have opened.
shop.nextIsGuaranteed: The next one is a guaranteed {rarity}
shop.coatsHint: Colour only, and kept through every rebirth.
leaderboard.distance.hint: Floors climbed across every life. Rewards persistence, not one lucky run.
leaderboard.lives.hint: Lives spent. Every one of them was a record beaten to be worth spending.
shop.gemsHint: Gems come from Guardians, one floor at a time. They do not inflate, so a price here means the same thing at any height.
bag.sealNone: No set yet — three pieces of one rarity start one.
bag.noMatch: Nothing like that in the bag.
idle.sellAllAsk: Sell all {n} spares for {gold} gold? Nothing comes back.
flair.quiet: While it is on, only finds better than what the cat wears announce themselves. The rest waits in the bag.
leaderboard.chests.hint: Chests opened. Gems come from Guardians, so this is a record of height spent on luck.
calendar.title: The thirty doors
calendar.hint: One a day. Miss a day and you lose the day, never the door — the count waits for you.
calendar.prizeHint: A coat that is never for sale.
shop.boostsHint: One use each, started from the arena. The calendar hands them out too.
idle.sellShownAsk: Sell the {n} pieces shown for {gold} gold? Nothing comes back.
forge.title: The Forge
forge.hint: The {n} best spares of a colour become one of the colour above, at their floor.
idle.equipBestPack: Dress this cat from the bag
